additional_info.subject: RE: ID0385063-DC/Si-D/FR- [D97xNg] Charger offline CRM:00796000885
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I went onsite yesterday (21
St
October) and the charger was in “Hello, Halo” mode in the screen with the LEDs off. So I reboot the charger manually and it came back online and green.
Then, I tried to reboot the charger from our supervision to see if the charger could reboot correctly. And it was blocked at 30% during the reboot. I tried that several times and the conclusion is that the charger is rebooting correctly if we did it manually but I’s always blocked at 30% when it’s done remotely.
When the charger was blocked at 30%, I tried to ping some components of the charger (please find attached the photos) and it was all good.
Do you know why the charger is blocked at 30% please when we do a reboot remotely ? Maybe a problem with the PLC that you may reset ?
We have removed the auto-reboot because initially it was the auto reboot at night that caused the charger to block. But a single reboot remotely will block the charger again and it will be out of order for the customers, so it’s not a good solution to remove the auto reboot.
Thank you,
Best Regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0385063-DC/Si-D/FR- [D97xNg] Charger offline CRM:00796000885
additional_info.body:
Hello Yacine, good afternoon.
I am taking over João's ticket since he is on Parental leave.
I noticed that you removed the Auto reboot, how do you want to proceed here? If you really want to keep the Autoreboot function, then we need to enable it and when this reoccurs we need to go on-site with the issue active to troubleshoot.
From my side it seems like the Routers are probably not being supplied the voltage and they don't turn on.
Otherwise, if the Autoreboot function is not really necessary then I would keep it this way. Is it also not possible to do a auto reboot via OCPP? I know that it's possible to restart a charger via OCPP but the scheduling might be need something from backend's programming.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
